note: Found by the F5 clojure lane on clojure/test/junit.clj (`(:ns (meta var))` inside a defmethod): declaration branches used to fire on KEYWORD-headed forms — the ns branch reset the alias table mid-file and corrupted currentNamespace for every following form (symbol owners became `m` / `(meta var)`, `t/inc-report-counter` stopped resolving). Declarations are sym-headed only now; clause dispatch reads kwd names through a separate helper. Pins: the alias survives the kwd-headed data form (still-resolves -> clojure.string/join) and no phantom module symbol was created.
